decision_summary: All three independent event-family phases failed the unchanged Phase 0 coverage gates. The company-information event schema, CNINFO announcement adapters, and PIT timing semantics are retained as reusable infrastructure for the canonical population tracker (#324). No model search is reopened.
retained_components: Generic company-information event schema with revision/timing semantics
Primary CNINFO adapters: earnings, buyback/unlock, holding changes
Focused tests for revision, provider failure, and coverage
